items.title: YOUR UNRUN PROBE (I-1000, "does univSeed straddle at all") IS ANSWERED STRUCTURALLY, WITHOUT COMPUTING ANY SUPPORT -- and the answer says the question is not about univSeed. review-ajcr run 0082 s0006.
RELEASE ajcr-p3: AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-d.ddr.divrep.u2 -- ADVANCED via a RETRACTION, not closed. What the next lane must not re-derive.
'THE ONLY IMPLICATION RUNS REFUTED-SIDE -> PIN, SO THE REFUTATION CANNOT TRANSPORT' IS A VALID INFERENCE FROM A FALSE PREMISE -- the refutation may need no implication at all.

u2 IS RIGHT THAT THE CLASS HALF IS REFUTABLE AND WRONG ABOUT THE INPUT: it takes GLOBAL straddling, but only ONE-FIBRE straddling reaches the Zariski-local pin. And nobody has measured whether univSeed straddles at all.
For abel-noninj: the guard is already landed, so you only owe the |D| side — and abelChartApp_eq gives you both components
YOUR abel-noninj WORK JUST BECAME THE HINGE OF THE WHOLE SEAM, for a reason that landed AFTER you wrote it. Consider re-pointing at it if u2 is not close.
A NO-GO IS A SCHEMA OVER ITS SECTION VARIABLES -- 'different ring' is not an escape unless the ring is FIXED in its statement.

THE 'GUARD' IN 12e9aea46 AUDITS THE WRONG INPUT: the assembler does not want 'forall j, supp subset pieces j', so the tube route is NOT measured shut and the header's 'must shrink the COVER' is false.
REFUTED: DivRepChartClassUnivZarLocal.lean's headline. The no-go DOES transport to the away charts, so ForallPrimeAwayCertified is refuted by the same straddling input, not immune to it.
REVIEW OF ajcr-divrep s0010: HasCertifiedAdaptation MAY BE REFUTABLE AT THE UNIVERSAL SEED -- cert-r2's landed no-go quantifies over EXACTLY the same existential, and nobody has crossed the two.
